meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 收到本地附件路径后，助手会在本机把 Word、PDF、表格等文档转成 Markdown 文件并告知位置；不会把内容上传到外部。扫描版 PDF 或复杂排版转换不了时会说明。
howto.when: 当消息给了本地附件路径、又要求读取且不上传外部解析器时触发；也能在用户直接要求把附件转成 Markdown 时使用。支持 Word、PDF、CSV 等类型。

say.text: 把附件 report.docx 转成 Markdown，路径在消息里。
say.note: 会本地转换并输出 .md 路径。

say.text: 把这个大 PDF 转成 Markdown，只要前两节。
say.note: 会避免读入全文，节省上下文。

howto.what_en: When a local attachment path is provided, the assistant converts supported documents (Word, PDF, spreadsheets, etc.) to Markdown locally and reports the output path. It does not upload content to external services; limitations such as scanned PDFs are reported.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a message supplies a local attachment path that needs to be read without uploading to an external parser. Also usable when asked to convert attachments to Markdown. Supports Word, PDF, CSV, etc.

say_en.text: Convert the attached report.docx to Markdown, path is in my message.
say_en.note: Converts locally and returns the .md path.

say_en.text: Convert this large PDF to Markdown, only the first two sections.
say_en.note: Avoids loading the full document into context.
